entities.name: Sunset
entities.description: Native survivor of Duskmourn, member of the carnival's foraging team, captured by the Cult of Valgavoth.

entities.name: Cult of Valgavoth
entities.description: Cult that captured survivors in a cavern.

entities.name: Rill
entities.description: Survivor who agreed to become a cultist.

entities.name: City
entities.description: Survivor who betrayed Sunset's raiding team.

entities.name: Winter
entities.description: Betrayed and sealed others in the room with the cultists.

events.summary: Sunset's raid with Rill and City was ambushed by an unexpected Wickerfolk.
events.quote: where he and his team faced an ambush by an unexpected Wickerfolk .

events.summary: Sunset was caught off guard by City's betrayal and later captured by the Cult of Valgavoth.
events.quote: Sunset was captured by the Cult of Valgavoth .

events.summary: Rill gave in to the cultists' demands and agreed to become one of them.
events.quote: The wounded Rill finally gave in to the cultists' demands, agreeing to become one of them.

events.summary: Winter betrayed Niko, the Wanderer and Nashi, sealing them in with the cultists.
events.quote: after a betrayal by Winter , who sealed them in the room with the cultists.
